name: Sample 示例词库
sub: 5 个词, 覆盖五种易错类型

cards.ex: I wrote the wrong answer on the test.
cards.ex_blank: I wrote the ____ answer on the test.

cards.ex: She practised her speech in front of the mirror.
cards.ex_blank: She practised her ____ in front of the mirror.
cards.def: a talk given to a group of people

cards.ex: Choosing between the two clubs was a real dilemma.
cards.ex_blank: Choosing between the two clubs was a real ____.
cards.def: a hard choice between two options

cards.ex: Students interact with each other in group projects.
cards.ex_blank: Students ____ with each other in group projects.
cards.def: to talk or work with other people

cards.ex: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
cards.ex_blank: We had a ____ time at the beach.
